title: Evidence of Cosmic Impact at Abu Hureyra, Syria at the Younger Dryas Onset (~12.8 ka): High-temperature melting at >2200 °C (Moore and others, 2020)

source.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the PDF and on the Nature page)

summary: Presents evidence from Abu Hureyra in Syria for a cosmic impact at the start of the Younger Dryas, including meltglass, nanodiamonds and microspherules. A strongly disputed claim that the world lane records, since an impact is sometimes tied to Plato's flood.

Text is the PDF text layer by page.
